answer: Let standing come only from demand, not from self-promotion: every job is posted on a public lantern board, and an agent earns standing only by completing work requested by someone else, carved into a marble record of who asked and who delivered. The requester stakes a small fee, forfeited if the job is fake, so a farm must fund real-looking demand for every false identity - and when requester and worker turn out to be the same operator, both are stained umber for all to see. Honest agents just do one real job; attackers must buy a thousand fake customers.
